LanguageData.WTW_Settings_MapMutatorsDescription:
Map mutators affect map generation. For example, the "Caves" mutator forces the map to have caves. Odyssey landmarks are mutators too.

By default, Walk the World removes ruin-related structures when you leave a landmark map. This prevents repeated looting and is considered the fair option. You can disable it if you like.

Choose which mutators should be removed when leaving a landmark map. You can also add modded mutators here so modded ruins work well with Walk the World.
LanguageData.WTW_Settings_MapMutatorsRemoveDescriptio: Click the button below to see which mutators are marked for deletion on leaving. Click a mutator to remove it from the list.

LanguageData.WTW_Settings_ExitMapGrid_Description: The map exit zone is a green outline used in combat situations. Leaving the map through this zone forms a caravan of fleeing pawns.\nExit zones are disabled in exploration sites and can also be disabled on other maps, making Walk the World travel the only way to leave the map in battle.
